Frequently asked questions

Website Design, SEO & Digital Marketing FAQs

Straight answers to the questions Chennai business owners ask most about websites, SEO, Google Ads and working with Kavitha Digital.

  • Website design and development
  • SEO and local SEO
  • Google Ads and social media
  • Working with Kavitha Digital

Website design and development

How much does website design cost in Chennai?

It depends on the number of pages, custom design, content writing and features such as booking or e-commerce. We provide a written quote after a short consultation. Our guide to website design cost in Chennai explains the main factors.

How long does it take to build a website?

A focused business website typically takes a few weeks from approved plan to launch. Larger websites, online stores and projects waiting on content take longer. We agree a timeline at the start.

Will my website be mobile friendly?

Yes. Every site is designed mobile-first and tested on phones, tablets and desktops. See responsive web design.

Can you redesign an existing website?

Yes. We keep what works, improve what doesn't and protect your existing search visibility where possible. See website design.

Who owns the domain and website?

We recommend registering your domain and hosting in your business's name, and set things up that way wherever possible so you stay in control.

Can you build an online store?

Yes. See e-commerce website development for platforms, payments and delivery options.

SEO and local SEO

How long does SEO normally take?

Most websites see meaningful movement within three to six months, depending on competition and how much needs fixing. SEO is an ongoing investment. See our SEO services.

What is local SEO?

Local SEO improves how your business appears in location-based searches and on Google Maps, through your Google Business Profile, consistent listings, reviews and local website content. See local SEO.

Can SEO help businesses in Pallikaranai?

Yes. Searches like “clinic in Pallikaranai” or “website designer near me” are local by nature, and a well-optimised profile and website help you appear in them. See our Pallikaranai page.

Do you guarantee first-page rankings?

No. Nobody controls Google's results, so guarantees are a warning sign. We commit to transparent, ethical work and clear reporting.

Do you provide SEO after website development?

Yes. Every website launches with SEO foundations, and ongoing SEO is available as a separate service.

Google Ads and social media

Do you manage Google Ads?

Yes — account setup, keywords, ads, landing pages, conversion tracking and monthly optimisation. See Google Ads management.

How much should I spend on ads?

It depends on competition, the areas you target and the value of a customer. We recommend a starting budget after research and adjust it based on results. Ad spend is separate from management fees.

Do you run Facebook and Instagram ads?

Yes, for awareness, website traffic, messages and lead generation. See social media marketing.

Should I choose SEO or Google Ads?

Ads are fast; SEO lasts. Many small businesses use both. Our article on SEO vs Google Ads explains how to decide.
